narrative.intro: Clark Construction Group has $495M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, across 17 awards with an average award size of $29.1M. Clark Construction Group's obligations are up 0.6% year over year. The Department of Defense is the largest buyer, obligating $415M so far, followed by the General Services Administration with $76.9M. Clark Construction Group wins work mainly in construction markets: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $316M, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $145M, and Site Preparation Contractors accounts for $33.7M. Fiscal-year historical obligations show Clark Construction Group received $167M in FY21, $178M in FY22, $603M in FY23, $1.6B in FY24, and $492M in FY25. The current-year total is a fiscal year to date figure and represents partial-year totals. Clark Construction Group’s award pipeline currently reflects 17 awarded contracts; the average award-value figure appears as $29.1M. These figures are contract obligations except where table notes specify otherwise.

sections.heading: Who are Clark Construction Group's biggest federal customers?
sections.body: The Department of Defense is Clark Construction Group's largest federal customer with $415M in obligations in FY2026 to date. The General Services Administration follows with $76.9M, and smaller buyers include the Smithsonian Institution with $1.6M and the Department of Justice with $1.2M. Other agencies buying from Clark Construction Group include the Department of Health and Human Services with $953K and the Department of Homeland Security with $10K.

sections.heading: What markets does Clark Construction Group serve for the federal government?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is Clark Construction Group's largest market with $316M in obligations in FY2026 to date. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction is the next largest market with $145M, and Site Preparation Contractors accounts for $33.7M. Clark Construction Group's federal work is concentrated in building and heavy civil construction markets.

Clark Construction Group also provides Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction services with $145M in obligations and Site Preparation Contractors services with $33.7M in obligations.
